# What changed in the Exterior

One passage, under Its alternative.

## Cartwell

- Old: "The checkout shops leave for, or come from ([its public pricing page](https://cartwell.example/pricing), read 2026-11-20)."
- New: the same, then "It now sells a till of its own, so a shop can leave us at the counter too ([its news page](https://cartwell.example/news), read 2026-11-24)."
- Why: a rival that also sells the till competes for the whole counter, not only the checkout page.
- Source: [Cartwell's news page](https://cartwell.example/news), read 2026-11-24.
